problem_text: A student prompts AI with "Draw a bat in the air." and gets a picture of a baseball bat flying out of a batter's hand instead of the animal flying in the air. What does this reveal about how AI reads prompts?

solution.option: AI understands context and chooses the correct meaning of ambiguous words.
AI matches individual words to common associations without fully considering context.
AI cannot process any prompts involving animals.
AI always chooses the least common meaning of a word.
